package.description: Free software for Windows operating systems to configure LANCOM devices in small and medium-sized networks

en-US.description: Free software for Windows operating systems to configure LANCOM devices in small and medium-sized networks
en-US.longDescription: LANCOM customers don’t just buy a product – they receive an all-round solution. An important part of this solution package is the free LANCOM Management System LCMS, the management software for all LANCOM routers, access points, and wireless LAN controllers. It offers an easy-to-use user interface for configuring and monitoring LANCOM devices in both local and remote networks. The software includes the three components LANconfig, LANCOM LANmonitor, and WLANmonitor.
en-US.name: LANconfig

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Windows 操作系统的免费软件，用于配置中小型网络中的 LANCOM 设备
zh-CN.longDescription: LANCOM 客户购买的不仅是一款产品——他们获得的是全方位的解决方案。该解决方案包的重要组成部分是免费的 LANCOM 管理系统 LCMS，这是适用于所有 LANCOM 路由器、接入点和无线局域网控制器的管理软件。它提供了直观易用的用户界面，用于配置和监控本地及远程网络中的 LANCOM 设备。该软件包含三大组件：LANconfig、LANCOM LANmonitor 以及 WLANmonitor。
